fact: Decree No. 816 of 2025 issued the Executive Regulations of Law No. 151 of 2020 on 1 November 2025, in force the next day, and the Personal Data Protection Center is already established and issuing licences and registrations, with full compliance due 31 October 2026.
title: The Egyptian Personal Data Protection Regime - What You Need to Know Ahead of 31 October 2026
